bibliographic.title: pickles ponders... pats
bibliographic.author: KA Tan
bibliographic.description:
WARNING: PAT AT YOUR OWN RISK!

A silly little dialogue between you and a sweet little cat... can you get through the day without getting chomped once?
  • Made for Dialogue Jam
  • Computer: Use arrows to interact or spacebar to progress / Mobile: swipe up or down to play! 
  • Shout out to the pickles appreciation club
  • Part 1 of ? for the Pickles Ponders series 
  • Made using the Binksi visual novel template by Princess Internet Cafe
